[paṭi + paharati], strikes in return, returns a blow; Spk I 134, 11 (yo pana akkosantaṃ na paccakkosati … paharantaṃ na ~ati); Mp III 142, 1 (bhaṇḍantaṃ paṭibhaṇḍatī ti paharantaṃ ~ati); — part.pr. paṭi(p)paharanta, mfn. , Spk III 102, 7 ; Dhp-a I 51, 4 ; — absol. paṭipaharitvā, Spk I 97, 8 (pahaṭassa ca ~itvā sukhaṃ uppajjati, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee paṭiharitvā); — see also appaṭipaharaṇa.
